/* User.findUserList */ select a.* , ifnull(b.tot_annual_day, 0) as tot_annual_day , ifnull(b.used_annual_day, 0) as used_annual_day , ifnull(b.add_annual_day, 0) as add_annual_day , ifnull((b.tot_annual_day - b.used_annual_day + b.add_annual_day), 0) as calc_annual_day from ( select user_no , user_id , user_name , birth_dt , join_dt , ifnull(user_tel, emergency_tel) as user_tel , depart , `position` as pos , use_yn , date_format(mod_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as mod_dt from tb_user a
order by join_dt desc limit #{firstIndex}, #{recordCountPerPage} ) a left join tb_annual b on a.user_no = b.user_no and b.year = date_format(now(), '%Y')
mapper.sql:
where 1=1
and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
and use_yn = #{useFlag}
and use_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: /* User.getUser */ select a.user_no , a.user_id , a.user_name , a.password , a.birth_dt , a.join_dt , a.user_tel , a.emergency_tel , a.depart , `position` , a.user_auth , a.user_email , a.post_code , a.addr_basic , a.addr_detail , a.addr_extra , a.use_yn , a.file_path , date_format(a.mod_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as mod_dt , a.mod_no , date_format(now(), '%Y') as current_year , ifnull(b.tot_annual_day, 0) as tot_annual_day , ifnull(b.used_annual_day, 0) as used_annual_day , ifnull(b.add_annual_day, 0) as add_annual_day , ifnull((b.tot_annual_day - b.used_annual_day + b.add_annual_day), 0) as calc_annual_day from tb_user a left join tb_annual b on a.user_no = b.user_no and b.year = date_format(now(), '%Y') where a.user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: /* User.insertAnnual */ insert into tb_annual ( `year` , user_no , tot_annual_day , used_annual_day , add_annual_day ) select date_format(now(), '%Y') , #{userNo} , ( case when a.diff_month < 12 then a.diff_month else 15 + ((a.diff_year - 1) div 2) end ) , 0 , 0 from ( select timestampdiff(month, #{joinDt}, date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d')) as diff_month , timestampdiff(year, #{joinDt}, date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d')) as diff_year ) as a
mapper.select: /* User.findUsedAnnualList */ select annual_no , occur_dt , annual_type , reason , occur_day , date_format(mod_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as mod_dt , mod_no from tb_annual_used where user_no = #{userNo} and occur_dt like concat(#{searchYear}, '%') order by occur_dt

/* User.getUserAnnualSummary */ select a.user_no , ifnull(b.tot_annual_day, 0) as tot_annual_day , ifnull(b.used_annual_day, 0) as used_annual_day , ifnull(b.add_annual_day, 0) as add_annual_day , ifnull((b.tot_annual_day - b.used_annual_day + b.add_annual_day), 0) as calc_annual_day from tb_user a left join tb_annual b on a.user_no = b.user_no and b.year = #{searchYear} where a.user_no = #{userNo}
